app.name: DynamoDB System Status Manager
app.short_description: Monitor and toggle operational status of critical systems stored in AWS DynamoDB
app.long_description: Enable support agents to view and update the operational status of critical systems (payment processing, customer websites, etc.) directly from Zendesk tickets. Toggle between operational and offline states with visual indicators and instant feedback. Integrates with AWS API Gateway, Lambda, and DynamoDB for real-time status management.
app.installation_instructions:
1. Complete AWS setup (DynamoDB table, Lambda function, API Gateway) - see AWS_SETUP.md
2. Install this app in Zendesk
3. Enter your API Gateway API key as the webhookSecret when prompted
4. The app will appear in the ticket sidebar
5. Toggle system status with one click

webhookSecret.label: API Gateway API Key
webhookSecret.helpText: Enter the x-api-key from your AWS API Gateway. This is stored securely and used to authenticate requests to your Lambda function.
